item.title: From Income to Wealth Inequality: Trickle-Down vs. Capital Gains
item.description: This paper studies how the general-equilibrium effects of rising permanent labor income inequality feed back on the distribution of wealth through trickle-down and capital gains channels.

item.title: Deep Learning Solutions of Large Non-Convex Life-Cycle Models
item.description: We introduce a novel deep learning algorithm for solving large life-cycle models with both continuous and discrete choices.

item.title: Labor Income Inequality and Stabilization Policies
item.description: This paper studies the impact of rising permanent labor income inequality on monetary and fiscal policy.

item.title: The Exit Channel of Monetary Policy
item.description: This paper studies the impact of rising interest rates on firms exit decisions.
